additional_sources.title: Bumi Armada Berhad: 2024 UKCS Environmental Statement - Armada Kraken FPSO
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted report page 15 contains a visually verified table of 2024 Armada Kraken GHG emissions by source and an explicit 230,790.76 tonnes CO2e total. Offshore UKCS values remain facility-level and cannot become England cadastral parcels.

additional_sources.title: CNR International: 2024 Environmental Statement
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted statement explicitly reports 2024 UK installation CO2 total and rounded flaring, fuel-gas and diesel components in million tonnes. Portfolio values are retained with stated rounding and no parcel inference.

additional_sources.title: Eni UK: OSPAR Annual Environmental Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted statement Table 1 explicitly reports 2024 Hewett decommissioning activity tCO2e for Valaris 72 diesel, DSV diesel and 52/5A removal plus a total. Activity rows are not cadastral parcel measurements.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Reported or monitored source data requires explicit scope or facility, pollutant/gas, quantity, unit, period and method provenance. Offshore measurements remain facility, activity or portfolio level and cannot become England cadastral parcel values.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit or facility data supports identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Map/grid/boundary data supports spatial matching only; no measured emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Collection, guidance, aggregate or ambiguous-layout records cannot become parcel GHG without compatible observed quantity and verified parcel geometry.

web_research_basis: Fresh official GOV.UK/OPRED research on 2026-07-27. Bumi Armada page 15 was visually verified with the PDF screenshot tool. CNR and Eni machine-readable government-hosted PDF text contains explicit values; screenshot attempts returned cache misses and are recorded without OCR or chart inference.
